defects: Does not introduce an explicit base prime ideal p (as in gold's `p : Ideal R` with `P.LiesOver p`); instead relies on `Ideal.inertiaDeg`'s convention of implicitly using the prime lying under q (i.e., comap (algebraMap R S) q, aka q.under R) as the base prime. This is mathematically equivalent since `LiesOver p` forces p = comap q, but it changes the hypothesis/parameter structure relative to gold (one fewer explicit index variable and no LiesOver instance), so it is not a strict match even though the resulting proposition is equivalent.
